guidance.heading: Updated Business Outlook
section: The Company confirms that its revised guidance of total revenues and adjusted EBITDA provided in the second quarter of 2026 remains unchanged.
The Company now expects its capex for the full year of 2026 to be around RMB8,500 million, compared to RMB10,000 million of capex guidance provided in the second quarter of 2026.
This forecast reflects the Company’s preliminary view on the current business situation and market conditions, which are subject to change.
